overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long P Daily ETF (PUL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Everpure, Inc. (NYSE: P) stock PUL was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
